name: sticker-sunshine
note: Read by eye. keep = how it is made (copied verbatim); replace is set per slide.
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:

· PHOTOGRAPHY: a hyper-saturated editorial portrait shot from a LOW ANGLE in bright direct daylight against an open sky. Glossy and slightly over-sharpened, punchy contrast, skin catching wet specular highlights. Fine grain and faint disposable-camera print noise over the whole frame.
· GROUND: a clean vivid blue summer sky with soft blown-out clouds, edge to edge behind the subject. Nothing else in the background.

· STICKERS: small die-cut glossy STICKERS pressed flat across skin and surfaces — smiley faces, cartoon daisies, five-point stars, tiny hearts — in candy colours (baby blue, mint, pink, yellow, lilac). They sit on top of the image like they were stuck on, catching a little light.
· HARDWARE: chunky Y2K silver jewellery — a star-shaped nose ring, stacked ear cuffs, ball chains, beaded bracelets — plus tiny gem details, glossy and reflective.
· MOOD: joyful, playful, sun-drunk. A big genuine expression, tilted head, a sense of motion and life.
· PALETTE: saturated candy brights over warm natural skin and blue sky — nothing muted, nothing pastel-washed, nothing dark.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
